note: Graphic overlays drawn by kit/overlay.html as captions.js flips (modes 9 to 37). Original generic designs, drawn in code with the theme's colours and fonts; icons are Tabler (MIT) path data; techniques from the MIT repos in THIRD_PARTY.md are redrawn, no code copied. "cues" on any graphic are beat words or seconds that kit/spoken.cjs turns into "at" times from when you say them. Bring your own icon, image or screen recording where a graphic takes one, or the kit draws a neutral placeholder. "required" lists the worded fields a graphic cannot show without (kit/spoken.cjs keeps the graphic and leaves off any other worded field you do not say). Listed in npm run menu, the showcase, contract.json and the teardown mapping (kit/videomd2reel.cjs). Words on screen follow kit/spoken.cjs: the fields under "spoken" must be words you say in the graphic's window, or a recipe job drops them. "layer" on modes 11 to 37 is front, behind or auto: behind draws on the panel layer under the crown mask (kit/headmask.py), so only the top of your head (hair and crown) goes over the graphic, never your face or chin. auto is behind for a screen card, and for the others behind when the graphic sits in the top part of the frame (its y below "autoBehindY").

fields.ink: word colour (default a dark or white ink that reads on the seal)
fields.layer: front or behind (the burst goes behind the person when a mask is set)
fields.size: seal radius in pixels on the 1080-wide frame (default 400)
fields.head: burst width in head widths (a teardown measures it; the remake measures your head and sets size and y)
fields.head-y: burst centre below the head centre, in head widths

graphics.detect: a large pale or saturated yellow region with a spiky outline (low solidity), plus a short ordinal word read on screen at the same time

graphics.label: app or logo label: a top-lit icon tile springs in and a name plate wipes out under it; your icon image, or a monogram of the name

fields.icon: image file (png, jpg, svg) relative to build/ or absolute; leave out for a generic glyph
fields.tile: tile colour for the generic glyph (default the theme accent)
fields.size: tile side in pixels on the 1080-wide frame (default 210)

graphics.detect: a small square tile (rectangular outline, distinct colour) with a short label read just below or beside it

graphics.label: screen card: a dark window card (title bar, address pill, accent rim with a glow), inset in the lower middle, showing your screenshot or screen recording; optional pointer clicks and pan and zoom keyframes on beats you say

fields.src: image or video file (a screen recording plays in the card); leave out for a generic placeholder window
fields.source: a public page (a repo, a site, a tool) captured by npm run capture to a screenshot and a short scrolling recording, or a file
fields.subject: what the reference showed in the card (written by a teardown as subject~)
fields.cursor: pointer stops on the screen, "x y" pairs 0..1 separated by ; (the pointer glides in from the lower right, lands on each stop on its beat and clicks with a ripple)
fields.cam: camera keyframes, "zoom x y" separated by ; (zoom 1 to 4 on the point x y of the screen, 0..1); the camera eases so it lands on each beat
fields.cues: one beat per stop or keyframe, words or seconds separated by ; (each becomes the time you say it, written to at)
fields.at: beat times in reel seconds (else spread over the card)
fields.layer: front, behind or auto (default auto, which is behind: the top of your head goes over the card where it reaches into it; your face and body stay under it)

graphics.detect: a rounded rectangle with a dark inside and a straight outline, wide and in the lower half, with small UI text read inside it
